# 4 bed detached house for sale

> Keogh Auctioneers are delighted to offer for Sale by Private Treaty this Detached Bungalow on circa 0.88 acres with a substantial Detached Garage/Workshop. The property is superbly located just off the N25 within meters of Pilltown Church and within 4 miles of the very pretty coastal village of Ardmore.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bed
- Plocha: 147 m²
- Energetická náročnost: C
- Lokalita: Pilltown, Kinsalebeg
- Cena: 580 000 €
